mentions.name: Lotus Eater
mentions.description: A fan site for the jamtronica band Lotus that pulls setlist data from Nugs via a scraper and provides data analysis of the band's shows, revealing patterns such as which songs rarely (or never) get played together across 900+ shows.
mentions.problem: The author had intuitions about the band's setlist patterns (e.g., that certain songs substitute for one another) that were hard to verify without aggregated setlist data.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a mostly vibe-coded fan site for jamtronica greats Lotus. I wrote/prompted a scraper to pull in setlist data from Nugs and have been having a lot of fun coming up with cool data analysis stuff to do with their sets.

evidence.value: It's a mostly vibe-coded fan site for jamtronica greats Lotus. I wrote/prompted a scraper to pull in setlist data from Nugs and have been having a lot of fun coming up with cool data analysis stuff to do with their sets.
